name: My Clips' Delete of a clip file in use, as admin, while bookmarks-clips-page-probe.mjs holds the clip file of its "clips-page-probe Act Held" bookmark open as a preview or a download in another tab holds it (read, sharing read and write but not delete): Delete clip on My Clips asks, the server tries three times and answers 409, and the dialog says "The clip file is in use (being played or downloaded); try again shortly." with the row as it was and the clip still there; then Cancel. The probe releases the file afterwards and deletes the clip, which works then.

steps.name: the held clip
steps.script: const R = () => document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="clips"]'); const K = (id) => String(id || '').replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); const row = (id) => { const r = R(); return r && id ? r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-row[data-jfbm-clip="' + K(id) + '"]') : null; }; const btn = (scope, title) => scope ? [...scope.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.getAttribute('title') === title) || null : null; const panel = (title) => [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel')].find(p => p.querySelector('h3').textContent === title) || null; const action = (dialog, label) => dialog ? [...dialog.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-actions button')].find(b => b.textContent === label) || null : null; const toasts = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].map(t => (t.querySelector('span') || t).textContent); const stateText = (x) => { const s = x && x.querySelector('.jfbm-clip-state-text'); return s ? s.textContent : null; }; const auth = () => ({ Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' }); const status = async (p, q, init) => (await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl(p, q), Object.assign({ headers: auth() }, init || {}))).status; const json = async (p, q) => { const r = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl(p, q), { headers: auth() }); return r.status === 200 ? r.json() : { status: r.status }; }; const ready = () => { const r = R(); const c = r && r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-content'); return !!r && r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-state') === 'on' && !!c && !c.hasAttribute('aria-busy'); }; const c = (await json('Bookmarks/Clips', { searchTerm: 'clips-page-probe Act Held', limit: 5 })).Items.find(x => x.Name === 'clips-page-probe Act Held'); if (!c || c.Clip.State !== 'Ready') throw new Error('no held clip: the probe seeds it first'); return { id: K(c.Id), file: c.Clip.FileName };
